title: LLMOps: From Development to Production
summary: Run the earlier RAG app and agent in production with versioning, evaluation gates, guardrails, containers, AWS deployment and monitoring.
outcome: Deploy and operate an LLM app where every change is versioned and evaluated before release, and health, quality and cost are visible while it runs.

project.title: LLMOps Project
deliverables: Take a RAG or agent app through the full lifecycle of this level
Version prompts in a registry with a production label; track experiment runs with params, metrics and artifacts
Gate every change in CI with the eval suite and show it blocking a deliberately regressed prompt
Run behind input, output and agent guardrails with every block logged
Serve as a streaming FastAPI backend with a Streamlit frontend, packaged with Docker Compose
Build and push commit-tagged images with GitHub Actions; deploy to EC2 via CodeDeploy behind a load balancer with Auto Scaling and Secrets Manager
Grafana dashboards with at least one working alert; traces with per-step cost and latency
Demonstrate one rollback (prompt or image) and write a runbook for one incident type

modules.title: What LLMOps adds

topics.d: What carries over from MLOps and what is new.
Running products on existing models vs training and hosting models.

topics.t: Why LLM systems are hard to operate
topics.d: Non-determinism, behavior change without code change, provider updates and per-request cost.
Code, prompts, model version, retrieval config, index and tools versioned together.
Stale indexes and retrieval drift vs runaway loops and tool failures.
Track, evaluate, guard, serve, ship, deploy, monitor, improve.

modules.tryIt: List every change that could alter your RAG app's answers tomorrow without a code edit, and note which ones you could currently detect.
modules.outcome: Explain what must be versioned, tested and watched for an LLM app to be safe to change.
modules.mentalModel: Code + prompts + model + data + tools = one release, and every part can change behavior.

modules.title: Preparing your apps for production

topics.d: The RAG app and agent are the two systems you will operate.
Model, prompts, retrieval params and tools as config.
A rebuild later produces the same system.
Request ID, prompt version and model version on everything.

topics.t: The Level 7 eval set as yardstick
topics.d: A fixed benchmark for all later changes.

modules.tryIt: Change chunk size and model through configuration alone, and confirm no code had to change.
modules.outcome: Two apps where every behavior-changing setting is explicit, versioned and recorded.

modules.title: Experiment tracking & prompt versioning

topics.d: Log params such as chunk size, top-k, model, temperature and tools.
Eval scores as metrics; prompts, configs and samples as artifacts.
Side-by-side to see which change moved quality, latency or cost.
Record baselines before touching anything.
Versioned, reviewed prompts deployed apart from code (e.g. Langfuse).
Promote by moving labels, not editing text in place.
Cached fetch with a pinned fallback if the registry is down.
Point production back at the previous version.
Tie each trace to the prompt version behind it.

modules.tryIt: Ship a second prompt version behind the staging label, compare it to production on the eval set, then promote or reject it.
modules.outcome: Keep a reproducible history of prompts and configs and change either without a deploy.

modules.title: Evaluation as a release gate

topics.t: The eval suite as DeepEval tests
topics.d: Turn the eval suite into automated tests in a standard runner.
Faithfulness, answer relevance, contextual precision; tool selection, completion, step efficiency.
Fail the build when a metric drops below its threshold.
Generated cases reviewed by a person before joining the suite.
Repeat runs, tolerance bands and fixed sampling settings.
Quick subset per change; full suite before release.
Same gate for prompts, models and retrieval changes.
Metric history shows which release moved it.

modules.tryIt: Deliberately weaken a prompt, push it, and confirm the gate blocks it with a report naming the failed metric.
modules.outcome: Stop any quality-lowering change from reaching production unnoticed.

modules.title: Runtime guardrails

topics.d: Checks on every request, before and after the model.
Guardrails AI validators that re-ask on failure.
Topical and conversational rails and when they beat a validator.
Injection and PII on input; ungrounded, off-topic and leaked secrets on output.
Validate tool args; cap steps, retries and spend.
Measure latency cost and wrongful blocks.
Log blocks and re-asks for review and tuning.

modules.tryIt: Send ten injection attempts and ten legitimate edge cases through the guarded app, then count wrongful blocks in each direction.
modules.outcome: Run both apps behind measured input, output and agent guardrails.

modules.title: Application serving & containerization

topics.d: App logic in a typed, validated FastAPI service.
Tokens streamed via SSE.
Stop token use when the client disconnects.
Report whether the provider and vector DB are reachable.
UI that only renders and calls the backend.
Plain-language errors, timeouts and guardrail blocks.
Small, reproducible images for backend and frontend.
Backend, frontend and vector DB together.

topics.t: Secrets at runtime, not in images
topics.d: Secrets from the environment, never baked in.

modules.tryIt: Start the full stack with one Docker Compose command on a clean machine and confirm streaming works through every layer.
modules.outcome: Serve both apps as a streaming, containerized stack that runs anywhere.

modules.title: CI/CD with GitHub Actions

topics.d: Unit tests, eval gate, then image build, in that order.
Tag images with the commit; push only gate-passing images.
Credentials as pipeline secrets, out of logs and fork builds.
Staging auto-deploys; production needs approval.
Redeploy a known tag rather than rebuilding.

modules.tryIt: Open a pull request that changes only a prompt and follow it through the gate, build and push.
modules.outcome: Automate the path from commit to a tested, tagged, deployable image.
modules.mentalModel: Push → unit tests → eval gate → build & tag → registry → staging → approve → production

modules.title: Deployment on AWS

topics.d: Docker on EC2 with an IAM role instead of stored keys.
Provider keys loaded from Secrets Manager at start.
Pull a tagged image and replace containers, gated by health checks.
Release styles with automatic rollback.
ALB with an idle timeout long enough for streams.
Add or remove instances with load.
LLM apps mostly wait on the provider.
Size scaling with provider limits in view.

modules.tryIt: Load-test the deployed app until it scales out, then work out whether instances or the provider's rate limit was the bottleneck.
modules.outcome: Run both apps on AWS with automated, health-checked releases and scaling.

modules.title: Monitoring & observability

topics.d: Instance CPU, memory, disk and network metrics.
Requests, latency percentiles, errors, model calls, tokens and blocks.
Health, traffic, latency, errors and spend together.
Error spikes, latency over budget, failed scaling and spend limits.
Per-step latency and cost through retrieval, model and tools.
Evals on sampled live traffic plus user feedback.
Production failures become new eval cases.

modules.tryIt: Find the most expensive request from the past day in your traces and explain where its tokens went.
modules.outcome: See health, behavior, cost and quality of the live system and feed findings back.

modules.title: Incidents, rollbacks & change management

topics.d: Provider outages, silent model updates, prompt regressions, stale indexes, runaway agents and cost spikes.
Model fallback, prompt rollback, image rollback, index rebuild or spend cap.
Signal, first action and decision owner per incident type.
Re-run evals whenever the provider announces a change.
Review each incident and add the case to the eval suite.

modules.tryIt: Simulate a provider outage in staging and time how long the app takes to fall back and recover.
modules.outcome: Detect, contain and recover from LLM-specific incidents with a practiced response.

modules.title: Capstone: LLMOps Project

topics.d: Take the agent or RAG app through every stage of this level.
Registry with a production label; runs with params, metrics and artifacts.

topics.t: A CI gate that blocks a regression
topics.d: Show the gate stopping a deliberately regressed prompt.
Input, output and agent guardrails, every block logged.
FastAPI + Streamlit, packaged with Docker Compose.
Commit-tagged images deployed behind a load balancer with Auto Scaling and Secrets Manager.
Grafana, a working alert and per-step traces.
One rollback demonstrated; one runbook written.

modules.outcome: A deployed LLM app where every change is versioned and evaluated, with health, quality and cost visible.
